name: Editorial Authority
tagline: A broadsheet front page for independent research
idea: The homepage is composed like the front page of a quality newspaper: a centred nameplate, one dominant lead story, a dated Latest column and dense supporting coverage on a twelve-column grid with fine column rules.
fit: Credibility rests on evidence. Newspaper conventions signal rigour and timeliness, help journalists and policymakers scan quickly, and give research, news and calls to act a clear, trusted order.
informedBy: A strong editorial lead with asymmetric, scannable hierarchy
A dated, typed stream of the latest news
Hierarchy carried by scale, spacing and rules, not boxes
distinct: The only concept built on newspaper conventions: nameplate masthead, column rules, a dated Latest column, drop caps and ruled boxes. The densest, most text-led of the ten.
buttons: Square corners: crimson for giving, ink outline for reading, slate text links, boxed uppercase tags.
imageDirection: Natural-colour documentary images in 3:2 crops, always captioned and credited: one dominant lead image, smaller pictures in disciplined rows.
navigation: Centred nameplate with date and Donate; sections between double rules; a sideways-scrolling section bar on mobile.
visualCharacter: Broadsheet newspaper: serif, ruled, dense and authoritative
contentEmphasis: Lead investigation, latest news and research publications
bestFor: An organisation whose reputation rests on credible, frequently published research and news for informed audiences.
tradeoffs: Dense and text-heavy: it needs a steady flow of strong content and photography, and feels less warm than story-led concepts.
